name: juniper
//overrides: Lift transitive deps past their CVEs without moving off Expo SDK 54 (D6). A key of the form pkg@range pins ONE major line: these packages are installed at several majors at once and only an in-major bump is API-safe — e.g. brace-expansion 5.x exports {expand} where 1.x exports the function itself, so a blanket ^5 would break minimatch@3 across the build toolchain.
//overrides-nanoid: nanoid is the only override here that SHIPS in the app bundle (nanoid/non-secure, used by @react-navigation/routers and expo-router for route keys). 3.3.18 is the in-major fix; do not take nanoid to 4+, which is ESM-only.
//overrides-not-fixable: Deliberately NOT overridden, because no fixed version exists: (1) image-size — GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr and GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq cover <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the latest publish. metro pins it, so metro, metro-config, metro-transform-worker, @expo/metro, @expo/metro-config, @expo/cli, expo and @react-native/metro-config all stay flagged. Build-time only; nothing here is in the bundle. (2) decode-uri-component — GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr covers <=0.4.2; 0.5.0 is fixed but ESM-only with no require condition, and query-string@7 is CommonJS and does require(). Forcing it would break deep-link parsing at runtime. This one DOES ship, via query-string -> @react-navigation/core + expo-router; every @react-navigation/core release to date still pins query-string@^7. Recheck both on the SDK 55 bump.
